name: SR Linux/SROS Streaming Telemetry Lab
description: Interactive streaming telemetry lab with Nokia SR Linux and SR OS. Deploys a small Clos fabric with complete telemetry stack (gnmic, Prometheus, Grafana) for real-time data visualization.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Interactive lab using containerlab with Docker-based telemetry stack components.

eval_notes: Complete Nokia telemetry lab environment. Excellent for evaluations involving vendor-specific streaming telemetry with interactive components. Topology: 3 leaf (SR Linux IXR-D2), 2 spine (SR Linux IXR-D3L), 2 DC gateway (SROS SR-1), 6 Linux clients. Demonstrates YANG coverage for streaming telemetry, gnmic configuration, and Grafana dashboarding.
